lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The highest-intensity maxima are clustered in the mid-lateral region, forming a roughly rectangular matrix with increasing spacing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow area on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 8-12 low-to-mid intensity luminance blobs, distributed unevenly with a higher concentration toward the base and anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin near the posterior base.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of very small, high-density speckling is visible on the leading edge and distal tip of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more sparse patterning on the primary flank.
